meta.name: agent-decision-receipts
meta.description: Mint a tamper-evident, post-quantum-signed receipt for a consequential agent action (deploy, delete, pay, grant-access, model decision) so it can be verified later from the certificate alone. Use when an autonomous agent takes a side-effecting action that may need to be proven later, or when satisfying EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping. Three decisions: whether an action needs a receipt, minting it, verifying it. Signing is delegated to the open-source OpenAgentOntology package. Not after-the-fact log analysis; not a hosted notary; not a legal opinion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为自主代理的关键操作生成防篡改收据，供事后验证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果自主代理执行了需要事后证明的敏感操作。
copy.tagline_en: Mint tamper-evident receipts for critical agent actions, verifiable later.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your autonomous agent performs sensitive actions that may need proof later.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会判断某个代理操作（部署、删除、付款、授权等）要不要留证；需要时，在执行前或执行时生成一份带签名的防篡改收据，记录谁、做了什么、依据什么政策，之后可仅凭这份收据离线验证真伪。
howto.when: 当代理要执行有副作用、影响重大且事后可能需证明的操作（如部署、删除、付款），或需要满足欧盟《人工智能法》第 12 条留档要求时。

say.text: 给这次部署生成一张收据，政策按欧盟 AI 法案第 12 条。
say.note: 会构造操作清单并签名出收据。

say.text: 验证这份 receipt.json，只凭证书，不联网。
say.note: 会重新计算哈希并检查每个签名。

say.text: 刚才的权限授予操作也开一张收据，政策按内部变更控制。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude decides whether an action needs a receipt, mints a signed tamper-evident receipt recording who/what/policy, and later verifies authenticity and integrity from the certificate alone, offline.
howto.when_en: When an autonomous agent is about to take a side-effecting, consequential action that may need proof later (e.g., deploy, delete, pay), or when EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping applies.

say_en.text: Mint a receipt for this deploy, policy under EU AI Act Art 12.
say_en.note: Builds the action manifest and signs a receipt.

say_en.text: Verify this receipt.json from the certificate alone, offline.
say_en.note: Recomputes the hash and checks each signature leg.

say_en.text: Also issue a receipt for that grant-access action, policy internal change control.
say_en.note: Mints a receipt for the authorization action.
